name: DEAD DOLLS NEVER DIE
source:
A linear visual novel about two girls taking a train to "The Last Station" to start a new life away from the curses that have bound them in the past. 

[From [url=https://gutterbride.itch.io/dead-dolls-never-die]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部线性视觉小说，讲述两个女孩乘坐火车前往“最后一站”，开始远离过去束缚她们的诅咒的新生活。

[来自[url=https://gutterbride.itch.io/dead-dolls-never-die]itch.io[/url]]
